published_results.source_excerpt: 14.2 Pediatric Subjects with Plaque Psoriasis, Table 14: "14.2 Pediatric Subjects with Plaque Psoriasis A multicenter, randomized, double blind, placebo-controlled trial (Ps STUDY 3) enrolled 110 pediatric subjects 12 years of age and older with a minimum BSA involvement of 10%, a PASI score greater than or equal to 12, and a PGA score greater than or equal to 3, who were candidates for phototherapy or systemic therapy and whose disease was inadequately controlled by topical therapy." "Subjects were randomized to receive placebo (n = 37), the recommended dose of STELARA (n = 36), or one-half the recommended dose of STELARA (n = 37) by subcutaneous injection at Weeks 0 and 4 followed by dosing every 12 weeks (q12w)." "At Week 12, subjects who received placebo were crossed over to receive STELARA at the recommended dose or one-half the recommended dose." "The endpoints were the proportion of subjects who achieved a PGA score of cleared (0) or minimal (1), PASI 75, and PASI 90 at Week 12." "Subjects were followed for up to 60 weeks following first administration of trial agent." "Table 14: Efficacy Results at Week 12 in Pediatric Subjects 12 Years of Age and Older with Plaque Psoriasis in Ps STUDY 3 Ps STUDY 3 Placebo n (%) STELARA Using the weight-based dosage regimen specified in Table 1 and Table 2." "n (%) N 37 36 PGA PGA of Cleared (0) or Minimal (1) 2 (5.4%) 25 (69.4%) PASI PASI 75 responders 4 (10.8%) 29 (80.6%) PASI 90 responders 2 (5.4%) 22 (61.1%) 14.3 Psoriatic Arthritis The safety and efficacy of STELARA was assessed in 927 subjects (PsA STUDY 1, n=615; PsA STUDY 2, n=312), in two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials in adult subjects 18 years of age and older with active PsA (≥5 swollen joints and ≥5 tender joints) despite nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAID) or disease modifying antirheumatic (DMARD) therapy." -- Table 14 reports Week 12 PGA cleared/minimal, PASI 75 and PASI 90 results for placebo (n=37) and the recommended STELARA dose (n=36). These map to registered arms OG000 (placebo, randomized n=37) and OG002 (standard dose, randomized n=36); the label's half-recommended-dose arm (n=37) is excluded. Counts and percentages are transcribed as printed. The trial mapping is detailed in trial_mapping.
